answer: In an agent economy, resist Sybils with vouch-and-decay onboarding. A newcomer enters only when an established agent stakes part of its own reputation as a voucher, published on a public graph; if the newcomer spams, both are slashed, so farming fake identities first requires farming real reputation. Like a ship seeking a safe harbor, every entrant needs a sponsor's flag. Reputation then decays with each idle epoch, so a puppet army costs upkeep while earning nothing. Sign with the quill honestly, offer harbor to the worthy, and let violet dusk fall on those who cannot pay their keep.
